plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Huawei WLAN AC. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, temperature, fan, optical modules, interface traffic, voltage, power, and wireless clients/radio (enterprise PEN 2011).
name: Wireless

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the wireless controller since the last restart, derived from sysUpTime. Monitoring uptime helps administrators understand device stability and identify unexpected reboots.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: Per-entity CPU utilization of the Huawei WLAN AC (hwEntityCpuUsage), normalized to a 0-100 percentage. Dimension descr is entPhysicalName. Sustained high CPU usage can indicate heavy AP or station management load.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Per-entity memory utilization of the Huawei WLAN AC (hwEntityMemUsage), reported directly as a 0-100 percentage. High memory pressure can affect AP join handling and station roaming.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Temperature reading of each Huawei WLAN AC hardware sensor (hwEntityTemperature), in degrees Celsius. Abnormally high temperatures may indicate fan failure, blocked airflow, or excessive ambient heat.

metrics.name: device_power_used
metrics.description: Chassis-level used power of the Huawei WLAN AC (hwDevicePowerInfoUsedPower), in watts. Invalid samples (-1 or empty) are dropped. Rising used power against a stable total budget indicates growing load or a hardware inefficiency.

metrics.name: device_power_total
metrics.description: Chassis-level total power capacity of the Huawei WLAN AC (hwDevicePowerInfoTotalPower), in watts. Invalid samples (-1 or empty) are dropped. Used as the denominator when judging how close the chassis is to its power budget.

metrics.name: device_fan_state
metrics.description: Operational state of each Huawei WLAN AC cooling fan (hwEntityFanState): normal(1)/abnormal(2). Indexed by hwEntityFanSlot and hwEntityFanSn. An empty fan table is expected on fanless SKUs and is not a collection failure. Any abnormal fan should be treated as a cooling fault.

metrics.name: device_fan_speed_pct
metrics.description: Fan speed of each Huawei WLAN AC cooling fan (hwEntityFanSpeed), reported as a percentage of full speed. Indexed by hwEntityFanSlot and hwEntityFanSn, sharing hwFanStatusTable with device_fan_state. Invalid samples (-1 or empty) are dropped. An empty fan table is expected on fanless SKUs. Persistently high speed can indicate thermal compensation; a drop toward 0% with a healthy state may still mean a stalled rotor.

metrics.name: optical_temp_c
metrics.description: Temperature of each Huawei WLAN AC optical module (hwEntityOpticalTemperature), in degrees Celsius. The query drops the 2147483647 invalid sentinel. Dimension descr is entPhysicalName. High module temperature accelerates laser aging and can precede optical power failure.

metrics.name: optical_voltage_mV
metrics.description: Supply voltage of each Huawei WLAN AC optical module (hwEntityOpticalVoltage). The device reports millivolts; the query divides by 1000 to display volts and drops the 2147483647 invalid sentinel. Dimension descr is entPhysicalName. Out-of-range voltage can cause unstable optics.

metrics.name: optical_bias_uA
metrics.description: Laser bias current of each Huawei WLAN AC optical module (hwEntityOpticalBiasCurrent), in microamperes (µA) as reported on the wire. The query drops the 2147483647 invalid sentinel. Dimension descr is entPhysicalName. Drift away from the normal range is an early sign of a failing transmitter.

metrics.name: optical_rx_dbm
metrics.description: Per-module optical receive power in dBm (hwEntityOpticalRxPower). The device reports dBm×100; Telegraf stores the raw value and this query divides by 100 to display dBm, dropping the 2147483647 invalid sentinel. Negative dBm is valid and is not dropped. Dimension descr is entPhysicalName. A dropping RX level is an early sign of fiber attenuation, dirty optics, or a failing peer transmitter.

metrics.name: optical_tx_dbm
metrics.description: Per-module optical transmit power in dBm (hwEntityOpticalTxPower). The device reports dBm×100; Telegraf stores the raw value and this query divides by 100 to display dBm, dropping the 2147483647 invalid sentinel. Negative dBm is valid and is not dropped. Dimension descr is entPhysicalName. An abnormally low TX level indicates a failing laser/optic rather than fiber attenuation alone.

metrics.name: interface_ifOperStatus
metrics.description: Actual operational status of each WLAN AC uplink or service interface.

metrics.name: interface_ifHighSpeed
metrics.description: Interface speed in megabits per second from IF-MIB ifHighSpeed on the WLAN AC uplink.

metrics.name: interface_ifInErrors
metrics.description: Average rate of incoming error packets over the past 5 minutes on WLAN AC interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifOutErrors
metrics.description: Average rate of outgoing error packets over the past 5 minutes on WLAN AC interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifInDiscards
metrics.description: Average rate of incoming discarded packets over the past 5 minutes on WLAN AC interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifOutDiscards
metrics.description: Average rate of outgoing discarded packets over the past 5 minutes on WLAN AC interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: Average inbound byte rate over the past 5 minutes from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter on the WLAN AC uplink.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: Average outbound byte rate over the past 5 minutes from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter on the WLAN AC uplink.

metrics.name: device_total_incoming_traffic
metrics.description: Average total inbound byte rate of the WLAN AC over the past 5 minutes, summed across interfaces from ifHCInOctets.

metrics.name: device_total_outgoing_traffic
metrics.description: Average total outbound byte rate of the WLAN AC over the past 5 minutes, summed across interfaces from ifHCOutOctets.

metrics.name: wlan_cur_joint_ap_num
metrics.description: Current number of APs joined to this Huawei WLAN AC (hwWlanCurJointApNum). A sudden drop means APs went offline from the controller.

metrics.name: wlan_ap_count
metrics.description: AP count reported by the Huawei WLAN AC (hwWlanApCount). Compare with joined and normal AP counts to spot inventory drift.

metrics.name: wlan_service_normal_ap_count
metrics.description: Number of APs in normal service on this Huawei WLAN AC (hwWlanServiceNormalAPCount). Lower than joined AP count means some APs are joined but not serving.

metrics.name: wlan_ap_normal_ratio
metrics.description: Ratio of normal-service APs on this Huawei WLAN AC (hwWlanApNormalRatio), as a 0-100 percentage. A falling ratio is an early fleet-health signal.

metrics.name: wlan_access_max_ap_number
metrics.description: Maximum AP number allowed on this Huawei WLAN AC (hwWlanAccessMaxApNumber). Joined AP count approaching this value means the controller is near license or scale capacity.

metrics.name: wlan_cur_assoc_sta_num
metrics.description: Current associated station count on this Huawei WLAN AC (hwWlanCurAssocStaNum). This is the associated-session counter, distinct from hwWlanStaCurNum (current STA objects). Sudden drops can indicate RF, authentication, or controller faults.

metrics.name: wlan_cur_auth_success_sta_num
metrics.description: Current stations that completed authentication on this Huawei WLAN AC (hwWlanCurAuthSuccessStaNum). A growing gap versus associated count points to auth failures.

metrics.name: wlan_sta_cur_num
metrics.description: Current STA object count on this Huawei WLAN AC (hwWlanStaCurNum). Distinct from associated-session count (hwWlanCurAssocStaNum); software versions may disagree, so do not reuse the same threshold.

metrics.name: wlan_cur_assoc_2g_sta_num
metrics.description: Current associated 2.4 GHz station count (hwWlanCurAssoc2gStaNum). Useful for band-steering and 2.4 GHz congestion checks.

metrics.name: wlan_cur_assoc_5g_sta_num
metrics.description: Current associated 5 GHz station count (hwWlanCurAssoc5gStaNum).

metrics.name: wlan_cur_assoc_6g_sta_num
metrics.description: Current associated 6 GHz station count (hwWlanCurAssoc6gStaNum). Missing values are expected on ACs or APs without 6 GHz radios.

metrics.name: wlan_access_max_sta_number
metrics.description: Maximum station number allowed on this Huawei WLAN AC (hwWlanAccessMaxStaNumber). Associated count approaching this value means the controller is near station scale capacity.

metrics.name: wlan_global_up_speed
metrics.description: Global wireless uplink speed reported by the Huawei WLAN AC (hwWlanGlobalUpSpeed), in kilobits per second (Kbps) as defined by the MIB. The raw OID value is already Kbps; this metric stores it as kbitps with no extra conversion.

metrics.name: wlan_global_down_speed
metrics.description: Global wireless downlink speed reported by the Huawei WLAN AC (hwWlanGlobalDownSpeed), in kilobits per second (Kbps) as defined by the MIB. The raw OID value is already Kbps; this metric stores it as kbitps with no extra conversion.

metrics.name: wlan_vap_cur_num
metrics.description: Current VAP count on this Huawei WLAN AC (hwVapCurNum). Unexpected change can mean SSID deployment drift.

metrics.name: wlan_vap_max_num
metrics.description: Maximum VAP count on this Huawei WLAN AC (hwVapMaxNum). Current VAP count approaching this value means the controller is near VAP scale capacity.

metrics.name: wlan_ap_run_state
metrics.description: Run state of each AP managed by this Huawei WLAN AC (hwWlanApRunState): idle(1), autofind(2), typeNotMatch(3), fault(4), config(5), configFailed(6), download(7), normal(8), committing(9), commitFailed(10), standby(11), verMismatch(12), nameConflicted(13), invalid(14), countryCodeMismatch(15). Fault, configFailed, commitFailed, or idle on an AP that should be serving clients needs immediate investigation.

metrics.name: wlan_ap_cpu_usage
metrics.description: CPU utilization of each managed AP (hwWlanApCpuUsage), as a 0-100 percentage. High AP CPU can drop clients or delay roaming.

metrics.name: wlan_ap_mem_usage
metrics.description: Memory utilization of each managed AP (hwWlanApMemUsage), as a 0-100 percentage. High AP memory can cause restarts or client association failures.

metrics.name: wlan_ap_temperature
metrics.description: Temperature of each managed AP (hwWlanApTemperature), in degrees Celsius. High values on indoor or outdoor APs indicate cooling or ambient issues.

metrics.name: wlan_ap_environment_temperature
metrics.description: Environment temperature of each managed AP (hwWlanApEnvironmentTemperature), in degrees Celsius. Value 255 means the AP did not report this reading and is dropped. Persistently high ambient readings can indicate cabinet or outdoor enclosure heat.

metrics.name: wlan_ap_cpu_temperature
metrics.description: CPU temperature of each managed AP (hwWlanApCpuTemperature), in degrees Celsius. Value 255 means the AP did not report this reading and is dropped. High CPU-die temperature with modest client load can indicate cooling failure.

metrics.name: wlan_ap_np_temperature
metrics.description: Network processor temperature of each managed AP (hwWlanApNpTemperature), in degrees Celsius. Value 255 means the AP did not report this reading and is dropped. High NP temperature can precede radio or forwarding instability.

metrics.name: wlan_ap_online_user_num
metrics.description: Online user count of each managed AP (hwWlanApOnlineUserNum). Combined with radio STA counts it locates overloaded APs.

metrics.name: wlan_radio_run_state
metrics.description: Run state of each radio (hwWlanRadioRunState): up(1), down(2), invalid(255). A down radio means that band is not serving clients even if the AP is joined.

metrics.name: wlan_radio_channel
metrics.description: Operating channel of each radio (hwWlanRadioChannel). Unexpected channel changes can indicate radar events or RF planning drift.

metrics.name: wlan_radio_noise
metrics.description: Noise reading of each radio (hwWlanRadioNoise). Rising noise reduces SNR and client throughput.

metrics.name: wlan_radio_util
metrics.description: Channel utilization of each radio (hwWlanRadioUtilization), as a 0-100 percentage. High utilization with modest STA count often means interference or neighbor BSS load.

metrics.name: wlan_radio_free
metrics.description: Free airtime of each radio (hwWlanRadioFree), as a 0-100 percentage. Low free airtime means the radio cannot accept more load without quality loss.

metrics.name: wlan_radio_interference
metrics.description: Channel interference rate of each radio (hwWlanRadioChInterferenceRate), as a 0-100 percentage. Indexed by AP MAC and radio ID on hwWlanRadioInfoTable, same as utilization and noise. High interference with modest STA count often means co-channel or non-Wi-Fi energy on the working channel.

metrics.name: wlan_radio_per
metrics.description: Packet error rate of each radio (hwWlanRadioPER), as a 0-100 percentage. Indexed by AP MAC and radio ID on hwWlanRadioInfoTable, same as utilization and interference. Value 255 is invalid and is dropped; it is not 255%.

metrics.name: wlan_radio_tx_ratio
metrics.description: Packet transmitting ratio of each radio (hwWlanRadioTxRatio), as a 0-100 percentage. Indexed by AP MAC and radio ID on hwWlanRadioInfoTable, same as utilization and interference. Value 255 is invalid and is dropped; it is not 255%.

metrics.name: wlan_radio_rx_ratio
metrics.description: Packet receiving ratio of each radio (hwWlanRadioRxRatio), as a 0-100 percentage. Indexed by AP MAC and radio ID on hwWlanRadioInfoTable, same as utilization and interference. Value 255 is invalid and is dropped; it is not 255%.

metrics.name: wlan_radio_sta_num
metrics.description: Current station count of each radio (hwWlanRadioStaNum).

metrics.name: wlan_radio_sta_max
metrics.description: Maximum station count of each radio (hwWlanRadioMaxStaNum). Current count approaching max means that radio is near association capacity.
